newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Stals sees fx easing for funds next - paper.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Stals sees fx easing for funds next - paper.

text.p: The next step down the road to the easing of South African foreign exchange controls is likely to see further relaxation for institutions, Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals said in an interview published on Friday.

"Further steps would include more lenient rules on the foreign investments of institutional investors which will broaden out to the relaxation of controls on the capital transfers of individuals," he told the weekly Mail & Guardian.
"The free transfer of the capital assets of emigrants will probably only be implemented in the final stages of the abolition of exchange control."
Economists estimate some 10 billion rand of blocked funds are currently held in the country by South Africans who have emigrated and who might be expected to ship out those funds as soon as allowed.
Stals stressed the central bank only advised the government on exchange controls with the final decision resting with Finance Minister Trevor Manuel.
